text:
sara: quick idea after yesterday's outage: we should standardize a 'recurrence taxonomy' and automate tagging so postmortems immediately surface long-term risk. thoughts? :mag:

tony: love this. taxonomy helps prioritization. propose three buckets: transient, recurrence-suspect, recurrence-confirmed. each has an escalation path.

lina: +1. suggest we add a lightweight detection heuristic that runs nightly: look for error spikes hitting >=3 hosts or >=2 deploy versions within 72h. if matched, tag as recurrence-suspect.

alex: can we make tags actionable? e.g., recurrence-confirmed => auto-create "root-cause deep-dive" ticket and require a senior owner + 30d SLA. recurrence-suspect => weekly check-ins.

sara: exactly. rough mapping I had in mind:
```
- transient: single deploy, single host, no prior similar stack traces in 90d -> owner: service oncall; keep-weekly followups optional
- recurrence-suspect: error pattern seen across >=2 deploys OR similar stacktrace within 30d -> owner: followup IC; escalate to senior owner if not closed in 14d
- recurrence-confirmed: repeated failures over >=3 incidents OR customer-impacting regression -> owner: platform lead + cross-team RCA; create RFC for mitigation, 30d remediation SLA
```

tony: nit: make sure recurrence detection stores an evidence pointer (log link, span id, commit range). that's the thing reviewers need.

lina: also add a 'confidence' field (low/medium/high) so automation doesn't flood people. low-confidence suspect tags require human verification before auto-creating tickets.

alex: suggestion for automation rule (pseudo-SQL):
```sql
SELECT trace_hash, COUNT(DISTINCT host) AS hosts, COUNT(DISTINCT deploy_tag) AS tags, MAX(occur_time)
FROM errors
WHERE occur_time > now() - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY trace_hash
HAVING hosts >= 3 OR tags >= 2;
```
if rows returned -> mark recurrence-suspect with evidence pointers.

oncall-bot: created automation task https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/RI-2001 to add recurrence tagging pipeline. :gear:

sara: governance notes: 1) human-in-the-loop check within 48h for low-confidence flags; 2) followup IC picks up recurrence-suspect within their rotation window; 3) if recurrence-confirmed escalate to oncall manager + weekly exec digest.

ton y: small ask: add a short field to postmortem template called 'recurrence_summary' where owners paste evidence + detection query. makes audits easier.

lina: I'll prototype the nightly job and include confidence scoring by matching stack trace hash + similarity score. will post prototype link in thread. due: 4 days.

alex: I'll update the postmortem template to include recurrence_summary + dropdown {none, suspect, confirmed} and make the evidence pointer required when suspect/confirmed. due: 48h.

oncall-bot: reminder scheduled: recurrence-tagging check-in in 72h (thread 1733333333).

sara: ok action items: lina -> prototype detection job (4d), alex -> template changes (48h), tony -> escalation playbook + SLA table (EOW). I'll draft the taxonomy doc and share a one-pager. If no objections I'll attach taxonomy to next postmortem and enable the nightly job in staging.

ton y: +1

lina: +1

alex: +1

sara: closing thread for now, will reopen when the staging job is live. thanks all :sparkles:
